name: Container
purpose: Centers page content with a max inline-size and token padding that morphs by container query.
scenarios: Wrap a marketing page section to a readable measure
Constrain a form on large screens
Provide a query container for nested layout primitives

size.description: Maximum inline size of the container.

variants.name: size
variants.description: Maximum inline size of the container.

antiPatterns: Do not nest containers to fake a grid; use Grid or Masonry.
Do not set physical left/right margins; centering uses margin-inline.

a11y.focus: Not focusable; children remain in document order.

responsive.strategy: Root is a query container. Compact uses tighter padding; tablet/desktop increase padding. Max size is the size prop.

breakpoints.compact: Full parent width up to size; padding space-2.
breakpoints.large: Wider inline padding at 80rem container width.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Centering uses margin-inline; padding uses padding-inline.
